title: Partial Settlement and Continued Hearing
description: Procedure for partial settlement of consumer disputes and continued hearing of unresolved issues

steps.step: Recording of settlement of partially settled issues by the Commission
Continuation of hearing of other unresolved issues involved in the consumer dispute

content.authority: District Commission or State Commission or National Commission
documents: Where the consumer dispute is settled only in part, the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall record settlement of the issues which have been so settled and continue to hear other issues involved in such consumer dispute.
